about.summary: Get sun position, sunlight phases (times for sunrise, sunset, dusk, etc.), moon position and lunar phase for the given location and time. Most calculations are based on the formulas given in Astronomy Answers articles about position of the sun and the planets : <https://www.aa.quae.nl/en/reken/zonpositie.html>.

Get sun position, sunlight phases (times for sunrise, sunset, dusk, etc.), moon position and lunar phase for the given location and time. Most calculations are based on the formulas given in Astronomy Answers articles about position of the sun and the planets : <https://www.aa.quae.nl/en/reken/zonpositie.html>.

name: r-suncalc
raw_meta_yaml:
{% set version = "0.5.4" %}

{% set posix = 'm2-' if win else '' %}

package:
  name: r-suncalc
  version: {{ version|replace("-", "_") }}

source:
  url:
    - {{ cran_mirror }}/src/contrib/suncalc_{{ version }}.tar.gz
    - {{ cran_mirror }}/src/contrib/Archive/suncalc/suncalc_{{ version }}.tar.gz
  sha256: dee42da5bd90996eb3a54605c0cac104747ffe24f7c224891018e0901a367894

build:
  number: 0
  rpaths:
    - lib/R/lib/
    - lib/
  noarch: generic

requirements:
  build:
    - {{ posix }}zip  # [win]

  host:
    - r-base
    - r-data.table
    - r-lubridate
    - r-magrittr

  run:
    - r-base
    - r-data.table
    - r-lubridate
    - r-magrittr

test:
  commands:
    - $R -e "library('suncalc')"           # [not win]
    - "\"%R%\" -e \"library('suncalc')\""  # [win]

about:
  home: https://github.com/datastorm-open/suncalc
  license: GPL-2.0-only
  summary: 'Get sun position, sunlight phases (times for sunrise, sunset, dusk, etc.), moon position and lunar phase for the given location and time. Most calculations are based on the formulas given in Astronomy Answers articles about position of the sun and the planets : <https://www.aa.quae.nl/en/reken/zonpositie.html>.'
  license_family: GPL2
  license_file:
    - '{{ environ["PREFIX"] }}/lib/R/share/licenses/GPL-2'
    - LICENSE

extra:
  recipe-maintainers:
    - conda-forge/r
    - thewchan
